name: aoe-triage
description: Triage open GitHub issues in agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires without a person in the loop: set one priority label, one type label and one area:* label, fill the Agent of Empires board's Status, Priority, Size and Roadmap state when the run's token can reach the board, remove needs-triage, and post at most one fixed-text comment for a clear duplicate or a bug report with no way to reproduce it. Runs on one issue (MODE=issue) or sweeps every open issue still missing a field (MODE=sweep, at most
author: agent-of-empires
